Here’s a curated list of top quantum sensing startups and closely related quantum‑technology startups that have raised notable funding (and/or are widely recognised by industry trackers). Many quantum sensing companies are early‑stage, so “significant funding” is relative—here we focus on known large raises, industry visibility, and available funding data.

Top 10 Quantum Sensing & Adjacent Startups by Funding / Profile (2025)

QLM (UK / Series A) – Gas‑leak detection & field sensors; reported ~$18.9 M total funding with ~$14.6 M Series A. 
Tracxn

Qnami (Switzerland / Series A) – Quantum microscopy and NV‑center sensing; ~$7.2 M raised. 
Tracxn

QuantumDiamonds (Germany / Seed) – NV‑center diamond sensor platform; €7 M seed funding (~$7.6 M). 
iqcapital.vc

QT Sense (Netherlands / Seed) – Nanodiamond cellular quantum sensing for diagnostics; €6 M. 
The Quantum Insider

Delta.g Ltd. (UK / Seed) – Portable quantum gravity sensors; £4.6 M oversubscribed seed. 
peterson.ventureradar.com

Nomad Atomics (Australia) – Quantum sensors for subsurface mapping and navigation (venture‑funded but exact totals not public).

peterson.ventureradar.com

Atomionics (Singapore / Pre‑Series A) – Portable quantum sensing for exploration; ~$12.7 M. 
peterson.ventureradar.com

QFX (UK / Seed) – Modular quantum hardware with sensing crossover; €2.2 M seed. 
EU-Startups

QSensato (Italy / Pre‑Seed) – Atomic/photonic quantum sensors; €500 K pre‑seed. 
The Quantum Insider

Honourable Mentions

Q‑CTRL (Australia/US) – Provides quantum control solutions enabling quantum sensing and computing; has raised $25 M+ Series B (~$43 M total). 
TechCrunch

IonQ / Vector Atomic (via acquisition) – IonQ acquired Vector Atomic (quantum sensing tech for PNT); the acquisition value was hundreds of millions of dollars (~$250 M+). 
Barron's

Notes on the Quantum Sensing Landscape

🔹 Quantum sensing often overlaps with quantum computing and quantum hardware startups. Pure standalone “quantum sensing” companies tend to be earlier‑stage and have raised smaller rounds compared to broad quantum computing players, but some deals (like Sparrow Quantum’s raise) are substantial within this niche.
